passages.title: Sample Student CV — Nadia Putri (Fictional)
passages.text: Nadia Putri | nadia.student@example.com | Grade 12 student. Profile: Interested in school library services and community projects. Education: SMA Nusantara, Grade 12 (2026–present). Activities: Library Volunteer (2026) — Organized donated books for the school reading corner. Project: Designed a poster for Reading Week. Skills: Teamwork, basic spreadsheet use, poster design. Nadia is applying to help at a school library. The email address is fictional and used for teaching only.

passages.title: Application Brief and Student Notes — Bima (Fictional)
passages.text: Opportunity: The school art club needs a student to help create posters for its open day. Relevant tasks: simple poster design and working with a team. Bima’s verified activities: Created two posters for his class project in 2025; helped classmates prepare art displays in 2026. Skills Bima can explain: basic drawing software and teamwork. Bima has not had paid employment and has not won any national awards. No home address or identity number is required for this school application.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a student CV?
choices: To tell a fictional life story
To present relevant and truthful qualifications
To guarantee the student will get a job
questions.explanation: CV merangkum pendidikan, pengalaman, dan keterampilan yang relevan secara jujur; tidak menjamin keberhasilan lamaran.

choices: Menyajikan kualifikasi yang relevan dan benar

questions.prompt: Which item is the safest basic contact detail for a student CV?
choices: A password to an online account
questions.explanation: Email profesional yang memang digunakan untuk menerima pesan adalah informasi kontak yang biasanya relevan. Data sensitif lain tidak seharusnya dibagikan tanpa alasan sah.

translationId.prompt: Informasi kontak dasar mana paling aman untuk CV siswa?

choices: I am always the best student.
questions.explanation: Bagian [[Education]] menyebut sekolah dan jenjang, bukan hobi atau klaim berlebihan.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes a real school project?
choices: I led hundreds of international offices.
Designed a poster for a class reading event.
I can do every job perfectly.
I have ten years of professional experience.
questions.explanation: Mendesain poster kelas adalah contoh pengalaman spesifik yang wajar bagi siswa jika benar-benar dikerjakan.

translationId.prompt: Pernyataan mana paling baik menggambarkan proyek sekolah yang nyata?
choices: Mendesain poster untuk kegiatan membaca kelas.
Saya dapat mengerjakan semua pekerjaan sempurna.
Saya punya sepuluh tahun pengalaman profesional.

questions.prompt: What activity does Nadia list in her CV?
questions.explanation: Nadia menuliskan [[Organized donated books]] sebagai kegiatan relawan perpustakaan.

translationId.prompt: Kegiatan apa yang dicantumkan Nadia dalam CV-nya?

questions.prompt: Which skill level does Nadia claim for spreadsheet use?
questions.explanation: Tercantum [[basic spreadsheet use]], yaitu kemampuan tingkat dasar, bukan ahli.

translationId.prompt: Tingkat keterampilan spreadsheet apa yang Nadia tulis?

questions.prompt: Which project is most relevant to the school art club opportunity?
choices: Creating posters for a class project
questions.explanation: Tugas klub seni memerlukan pembuatan poster; Bima memang pernah membuat poster kelas. Pilihan lain bukan bukti relevan.

translationId.prompt: Proyek mana paling relevan untuk kesempatan di klub seni sekolah?

questions.evidence: Created two posters for his class project

questions.prompt: What should Bima write about paid work experience?
choices: He has no paid work experience and can describe school projects.
He worked for ten years as a designer.
He must leave every section blank.
questions.explanation: Bima belum bekerja berbayar. Ia tetap dapat mencantumkan proyek sekolah nyata tanpa mengarang riwayat pekerjaan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang sebaiknya Bima tulis mengenai pengalaman kerja berbayar?
choices: Ia belum berpengalaman kerja berbayar dan dapat menjelaskan proyek sekolah.
Ia menjadi desainer selama sepuluh tahun.
Ia harus membiarkan semua bagian kosong.

questions.prompt: Which phrase is an appropriate action-based experience description?
choices: Assisted classmates in preparing art displays.
I am the most amazing person ever.
I probably know everything about art.
My friends say I deserve any position.
questions.explanation: [[Assisted classmates]] menyebut kontribusi yang dapat diperiksa dari catatan kegiatan Bima; yang lain klaim diri tanpa bukti.

translationId.prompt: Frasa mana menggambarkan pengalaman dengan kata kerja tindakan yang tepat?
choices: Membantu teman sekelas menyiapkan pajangan seni.
Saya mungkin tahu semua tentang seni.
Teman saya bilang saya layak semua posisi.

questions.prompt: Which personal information is NOT required for Bima’s school application?
choices: His home address and identity number
questions.explanation: Catatan pendaftaran menegaskan alamat rumah dan nomor identitas tidak diperlukan. Jangan membagikan data sensitif tanpa keperluan sah.

translationId.prompt: Informasi pribadi mana yang TIDAK diperlukan untuk pendaftaran Bima?

questions.evidence: No home address or identity number is required

questions.prompt: Which detail should Nadia emphasize for a school library application?
questions.explanation: Kegiatan relawan perpustakaan berhubungan dengan tugas yang dituju dan tercatat dalam CV contoh.

translationId.prompt: Rincian mana yang sebaiknya Nadia tonjolkan untuk lamaran perpustakaan sekolah?

questions.evidence: Nadia is applying to help at a school library

questions.prompt: What is the best final check before sending a CV?
choices: Check truthfulness, relevance, spelling, and unnecessary personal data.
Include a password so the reviewer trusts you.
questions.explanation: Cek ulang kebenaran isi, kesesuaian dengan tujuan, bahasa, dan privasi. Mengarang prestasi atau membagikan kata sandi justru berbahaya.

translationId.prompt: Apa pemeriksaan terakhir terbaik sebelum mengirim CV?
choices: Memeriksa kejujuran, relevansi, ejaan, dan data pribadi yang tak perlu.
Mencantumkan kata sandi agar penilai percaya.
